newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo state to sell CPFL whole - report.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo state to sell CPFL whole - report.

text.p: Sao Paulo state governor Mario Covas said the state's soon-to-be-privatized power utility Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) will be sold as a whole, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper reported Tuesday.
Previously, the state said the company would be split into two units, one for generation and another for distribution, the paper said.
CPFL, which is expected to be the first Sao Paulo state power firm to be privatized, is likely to be sold in late October or early November, Gazeta said.
